title: Segments
statementMd:
You are given an integer $*N*$. Consider all possible segments on the coordinate axis with endpoints at integer points with coordinates between 0 and $*N*$, inclusive; there will be ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5e54199c623e6698508e30637903d25ae30f0d42.png) of them.

You want to draw these segments in several layers so that in each layer the segments don't overlap (they might touch at the endpoints though). You **can not** move the segments to a different location on the coordinate axis.

Find the minimal number of layers you have to use for the given $*N*$.

## Input

The only input line contains a single integer $*N*$ ($1 ≤ *N* ≤ 100$).

## Output

Output a single integer - the minimal number of layers required to draw the segments for the given $*N*$.

## Note

As an example, here are the segments and their optimal arrangement into layers for $*N* = 4$.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8a475108c50ca3e7a56a047302228224fc3fa969.png)
statementZhMd:
给定一个整数 $*N*$。考虑坐标轴上所有可能的线段，其端点位于坐标在 0 到 $*N*$（含）之间的整数点上；这样的线段共有 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5e54199c623e6698508e30637903d25ae30f0d42.png) 条。

你希望将这些线段绘制在若干层中，使得每一层中的线段互不重叠（但它们可以在端点处接触）。**不能**将线段移动到坐标轴上的其他位置。

请找出给定 $*N*$ 时所需的最少层数。

## 输入格式

输入仅一行，包含一个整数 $*N*$（$1 ≤ *N* ≤ 100$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示绘制给定 $*N*$ 的所有线段所需的最少层数。

## 说明

例如，以下给出了 $*N* = 4$ 时的所有线段及其分层的最优方案。
